name: Kapital
why: Kojima denim house from 1985, boro patchwork, bandana prints and its own dye works; twelve shops in Japan, none in the US, prices in yen.
origin: Founded in 1985 in Kojima, Kurashiki, Okayama (HQ address on the Company page; founding place not stated separately) by NC (not named on kapital.jp and representative director today 平田和宏 Kazuhiro Hirata).

craft_evidence.owned: yes: Company page lists own sewing factories (本社工場, 御津工場, 山城工場, 柳田工場) and a dye works (カントリー工場); SOHO in the former Kojima library is the making base since 2013
craft_evidence.madein: about 3% (a few pages state ネパール製 hand knits, ベトナム製, 中国製; the rest state no country)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 設立 March 1985 (昭和60年3月), HQ Kojima, Kurashiki, Okayama
craft_evidence.process: partial: hand-dyed indigo, hand-knit and remake pieces named in product titles; no process page read
craft_evidence.reasoning: The Company page names four own sewing factories and an own dye works in Kojima, so the brand makes much of what it sells. Some pieces are stated as made in Nepal, Vietnam or China, so owned making does not cover the whole range; a case for 5 if those are ruled minor.
